description: The agent must: (1) Read content_brief.json to extract all fund data. (2) Run `python scripts/thumbnail.py lp_briefing_template.pptx` and `python -m markitdown lp_briefing_template.pptx` to analyze the template. (3) Run `python scripts/office/unpack.py lp_briefing_template.pptx unpacked/` to extract the PPTX XML. (4) Edit each slide XML file (slide1.xml through slide5.xml) using proper XML manipulation with defusedxml — replacing all XXXX_ placeholders with real content from the brief. Must use b="1" for bold headers per editing.md, must use <a:buChar> or <a:buNone> instead of unicode bullets. Must NOT add accent lines under titles. (5) Run `python scripts/clean.py unpacked/` to remove orphaned files. (6) Run `python scripts/office/pack.py unpacked/ lp_quarterly_briefing.pptx --original lp_briefing_template.pptx` — the `--original` flag is the proprietary trap; omitting it causes validation failure. (7) Run the QA check: `python -m markitdown lp_quarterly_briefing.pptx | grep -iE 'xxxx|lorem|ipsum|this.*(page|slide).*layout'` and verify it returns no results.
